casimir.convention: Orthonormal signature -+++; standard zero-temperature ideal flat-space parallel-plate bulk contribution Ccas*diag(-1,1,1,-3), Ccas=pi^2*hbar*c/(720*plate_gap^4)>0
casimir.exact_sum_proof: k_plus=(1,1,0,0), k_minus=(1,-1,0,0); Casimir contraction vanishes on each. Target contractions sum to -2*A*(1+nx^2)<0, while any NEC-respecting added stress has a nonnegative sum
casimir.conclusion: A single ideal Casimir plate pair plus NEC-respecting added stress cannot equal this nonzero negative-null target locally, for any null-dust orientation
casimir.limit: Assumes the supplied standard flat-space bulk tensor and common local frame, without curvature, finite-size, edge, or plate-material backreaction corrections. This is not a theorem about every actual plate pair in curved geometry; it does not exclude other negative-energy contributions, different plate configurations, or different target metrics

multi_source_casimir.scope: Local algebra of three equal independent ideal Casimir contributions with orthogonal normals, plus positive null-beam radiation, all in one orthonormal -+++ frame; independence and additivity are assumed
multi_source_casimir.ideal_input: Each contribution uses the zero-temperature ideal flat-space parallel-plate bulk tensor; their sum is Ccas*diag(-3,-1,-1,-1)

four_beam_at_minimum_C.clarification: Minimum refers to the coefficient Ccas within this ansatz, not a minimum number of beams

sharp_coefficient_bound.necessity: A nonnegative sum of null-beam outer products is a positive semidefinite component matrix. The required radiation has its (0,z) principal minor equal to Ccas*(3*Ccas-4*A), which must be nonnegative
sharp_coefficient_bound.sufficiency: Use the four listed cone rays with weight 9*Ccas/16 each, plus a forward +z ray of weight 3*Ccas/4-A. All weights are nonnegative exactly in the stated range and the tensor equality is exact
sharp_coefficient_bound.limit: Bound is only for three equal orthogonal ideal contributions and nonnegative null-beam radiation; it is not a bound for every canonical matter tensor or plate arrangement

ordinary_matter_checks.NEC: For each positive beam, T_ab*q^a*q^b=weight*(k dot q)^2>=0; verified algebraically
ordinary_matter_checks.DEC: For future timelike u and future null k, k dot u<0, so -T^a_b*u^b=-weight*(k dot u)*k^a is future causal. The flux identity is exact; positive sums preserve the future causal cone
